script.cover_1: Tomorrow, a client call. Nobody told you your part.
script.payoff: The better text gives the time, your role and the agenda.
script.caption: Preparing for a call takes less time than guessing for it. Send this to the junior who joins calls cold.
script.request: A manager wants a junior on a client call tomorrow.
script.pushy: Join tomorrow's client call. Be ready for everything.
script.professional: Please join the 4 pm client call. Your part is the demo, agenda attached.
script.why: It names the time, the role and the agenda, so the junior can prepare.
script.reply_me: Happy to join. What should I be ready for, and when do I speak?
